newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh cent bank reserves fall to 92.31 bn tenge.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh cent bank reserves fall to 92.31 bn tenge.

text.p: Kazakhstan's net reserves of hard currency and gold fell to 92.31 billion tenge as of May 1, the National Bank said on Thursday.

NOTE - May 1 data calculated on basis of 75.40 tenge per dollar and gold price of $340.45 per ounce. Bank did not provide breakdown of currency and gold reserves. 1996 data provided in dollars only. At official dollar rate May 1 reserves would be $1.22 billion.

National Bank Governor Uraz Dzhandosov told a news conference on Thursday that lower gold prices on international markets and traditional quarterly payments by the government on obligations to foreign creditors accounted for the fall in reserves in April.
